question: Mohit starts from point X, and travels a distance of 2 km towards north, and then turns right, and travels a distance of 1 km. Then he turns right and travels a distance of 3 km. Then he again turns right, and travels a distance of 1 km, and finally turns right again, and travels a distance of 1 km. What is Mohit's current position with respect to the starting point of the journey, X? (All the turns are 90 degree turns only)
solution:
According to the given information:

Mohit starts from point X, and travels a distance of 2 km towards north, and then turns right, and travels a distance of 1 km.

Then he turns right and travels a distance of 3 km.

Then he again turns right, and travels a distance of 1 km, and finally turns right again, and travels a distance of 1 km.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4617f9cfa1e28fc4a3aedd30d1aca9af3c5a0e050e90cb39056788300bbce267.png] 

So, Mohit's current position with respect to the starting point of the journey, X is** point X only**.

Hence, the correct answer is "Point X only".
